items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: she called Lou Shoobe (incredible) at CBS, why wasn't I called, and he proclaimed that he couldn't find me

ctx.x: Buddy DeFranco's girl friend was working at Downbeat, they weren't married yet, and so I called Downbeat to find out about it. So, she called Lou Shoobe (incredible) at CBS, why wasn't I called, and he proclaimed that he couldn't find me, and it became a cause celebre to the union and whatnot,

and I finally got it. So, we had 39 weeks once a week radio show which Roosevelt had claimed radio as an essential industry and it changed my 1-A status to 1-E or something, that you wouldn't be called, so for 39 weeks I was --
